text:
East Rutherford yɛɛ borough wɔ March 28, 1894, wɔ Boiling Springs Township mu. Ɛyɛ Bergen County borough ketewa a ɛwɔ Midtown Manhattan atɔeɛ bɛyɛ miles 7, na Meadowlands Sports Complex na ɛhyɛ mu — MetLife Stadium, Meadowlands Racetrack ne American Dream mega-mall wɔ hɔ. Meadowlands Sports Complex daa 1976 mu, na MetLife Stadium nso hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ 2010. Ɛwɔ mu ketewa nso a, borough no wɔ beaeɛ kɛseɛ wɔ agoprama abakɔsɛm mu: ɛyɛ municipality a ɛyɛ ketewa sen biara a ɛgyee Super Bowl, na wɔgyee Super Bowl XLVIII wɔ 2014, na ɛbɛgye 2026 World Cup final no.

Agoprama no amammerɛ no, ɛnyɛ borough no nko ara na ɛwɔ mu, na ɛwɔ New York/New Jersey metropolitan area a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ na ɛyɛ football-passionate sen biara wɔ United States mu. Metro no yɛ fie ma New York Red Bulls ne NYCFC, na wɔkae New York Cosmos a ɛwɔ 1970s ne 1980s mu, na Pelé ne Beckenbauer ka wɔn ho. Latino, European ne African diaspora fanbases a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ nso ma beaeɛ no wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ deep, polyglot wɔ global game no mu.

Ɛno a ɛpɛ no da adi wɔ gate no mu dedaw. MetLife Stadium ne Giants Stadium a ɛdi kan no, wɔtɔn nneɛma a ɛyɛ marquee internationals pii, fi Copa América Centenario final kosi Argentina–Brazil superclásicos. Bi-state reach a ɛwɔ market no mu no wɔ tournament identity no mu: World Cup no, wɔfrɛ beaeɛ no "New York New Jersey Stadium," a ɛkyerɛ sɛ fanbase a ɛtrɛ wɔ states mmienu mu, ɛnyɛ borough ketewa baako nko. Ɛyɛ metro no, ɛnyɛ East Rutherford nko, na World Cup branding no pɛ sɛ ɛkyerɛ no.
